title: He Got Out of Jail & Then Did THIS
description:
This man does everything to make sure he gets arrested a day after getting released from prison. It all began when an officer was dispatched to an apartment complex in reference to a violent individual who spat on a female employee. The complex owner wanted him trespassed but since he was a guest on the property, the officer couldn’t force the suspect out without his friend’s consent. The intoxicated male continued to threaten the officer with his aggressive demeanor after making several racist remarks to him. Some people just don’t want to feel the touch of reality until it’s slapped on their faces. The ex-navy loudmouth was instantly humbled after getting cuffed, almost like he was waiting for the arrest. The male was charged with assault on a law enforcement officer, battery on a law enforcement officer and resisting arrest.
